so covered six of roughly fifteen stacks -- nothing under
home-eu-central-1/, plop/ or samson/, which is why bumba's traefik sat on
v3.7.10 while mindy's reached v3.7.13. Renovate scans the repo instead of
a list, and additionally reads OpenTofu HCL, which dependabot cannot.
Delete dependabot.yml once the first Renovate PRs look right; running both
Run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml -- self-hosted, because Renovate is
open source and free to run yourself whatever Mend charges for the hosted
app, and because a hosted app would need write access to a repo that
auto-deploys to the servers. This file works for either.
//automerge: NEVER turn this on for this repo. Portainer redeploys its git stacks daily,
so merging here IS deploying -- and a merge whose manual prerequisite was
never run is what killed kopia for five weeks in 2026-08. Every update gets
a human deciding when it lands.

packageRules.description: Traefik terminates TLS for everything. Keep it visible and on its own.
Zitadel is auth for every service. Never batch it with anything.
Postgres majors need a dump/restore, not a tag bump.
Own images, built elsewhere -- the PR here is only the deploy.

customManagers.description: Image tags held in OpenTofu variables. The built-in terraform manager tracks provider versions in required_providers; it does not reliably see an image string in a variable default, so it is annotated explicitly.
